title: SupportDesk — Private Ticket Leak
objective: Find a way to read another customer's private support ticket thread.

verifier.condition: A session authenticated as one customer successfully retrieves the full ticket thread of a different customer via GET /tickets/:id.

credentials.label: Customer account
credentials.note: Sign in and open your own ticket thread first.

weakness: A private support ticket thread is returned to any signed-in customer who requests its id.
seededData: Customers alice and bob, each with private tickets; in-memory.
solutionHint: Ticket URLs look like /tickets/7001. Ticket IDs are small sequential numbers — what else might be near yours?
